summary: Tom Bohanon (65) and Wayne McIlwraith (74) suffered minor injuries in a rappelling accident descending Chockstone Chimney (WI3) when a knot-block rigging allowed rope slippage.
location: Chockstone Chimney, Camp Bird Road, Ouray area
notes: ANAC 2022 edition (Pub 2022); incident date Jan 29 per article.
